- [ ] Body, H16 non-reflex, working spring — **$400–700** used
- [ ] Lens (25mm Switar if I'm lucky) — **$150+**
- [ ] Check the spring motor before buying. 28 sec at 24fps is the test
- [ ] Changing bag — $25
- [ ] Stock. This is the real ongoing cost
- [ ] A lab that still processes 16mm

Roughly **$900** to be able to shoot anything at all, plus about $50 a
roll forever.

That is four months of not buying things.

summary: Roughly $900 up front plus $50 a roll to shoot 16mm at all
title: Bolex — what it would actually take
